environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway HTTP API with no request validation. Lambda execution role has AmazonRDSFullAccess. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with RLS policies defined but the DB_USER connects as the table owner (rds_superuser role), which bypasses RLS enforcement. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage. Environment variables DB_USER=postgres (superuser).

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no request validation, no WAF
